race.comment: Big field for the 2yo's but expect that to change a fair bit with the forecast conditions. ROYAL PRESS (1) has the race experience so we'll default to him. Both runs have been very good and fancy the Soldi form especially is strong for this time of year at least. Gets every chance from the gate. ODENKIRK (5) is an Ole Kirk colt down from Sydney who has won a couple of trials nicely on wet ground which can't hurt. Respecting. NATURAL EMOTION (7) was solid behind Soldi on debut at Flemington and that ties in with ROYAL PRESS, she has claims. Doubt it ends there.
